أتساهم (form VI)
# أَتَسَاهَمُ (ʔatasāhamu) /ʔa.ta.saː.ha.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَسَاهَمَ (tasāhama)
# أَتَسَاهَمَ (ʔatasāhama) /ʔa.ta.saː.ha.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَسَاهَمَ (tasāhama)
# أَتَسَاهَمْ (ʔatasāham) /ʔa.ta.saː.ham/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَسَاهَمَ (tasāhama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
